name: claude-dev-skills
description: Everyday developer skills for Claude Code: code quality, debugging, devops, data, docs and security basics. Forty-two skills in six plugins, each with a procedure, an output format and, where it helps, a tested standard-library script.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Review checklist, refactor planning, dead code and complexity reports, naming and error-handling audits, type coverage and test gap finder.

plugins.name: debugging
plugins.description: Bug reproduction minimiser, log triage, flaky test hunter, stack trace explainer, profile reader and a memory leak checklist.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Dockerfile hardening, GitHub Actions authoring, Kubernetes manifest and Terraform review, a Terraform apply gate, cron doctor, env file diff, release notes and a semver advisor.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: SQL query review, schema migration planning, CSV profiler, JSON Schema inference, regex builder and OpenAPI 3 contract review.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: README author, ADR writer, changelog keeper, onboarding doc, API docs from code and a postmortem writer.

plugins.name: security-basics
plugins.description: Secrets hygiene scan, dependency audit reader, HTTP security header check, JWT inspector, CORS review, auth flow review and a diff security review. For agent-specific security see agent-security-skills.
